login.intro: Charity Link is an application that helps connect you with a local charity to help you donate your gently used items to help those in need. There are many local orphanages that need your kindness and support to help all the children in need. Please join us and give whatever you can, every little bit helps. Thank you.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about how Charity Link works.
faq.footerTail: to update your profile contact details.

items.a: Charity Link connects contributors who want to donate gently used items with local charity organizations that support people in need, including children in orphanages.
Create a donation list, add items with photos and descriptions, then submit the list. Charity Link routes your list to a local charity based on your location.

items.q: How is my donation list matched to a charity?
items.a: When you submit a list, the app selects a charity organization using your contributor location and the app’s routing rules, so nearby charities receive relevant donations.

items.q: What happens after I submit a donation list?
items.a: The charity reviews each item, then can send you a response. You’ll get a notification (including WhatsApp when available) and can view their message and contact details.

items.q: How do I contact the charity after they respond?
items.a: On your donation lists page, open a reviewed list and use Contact Charity to view their profile, including WhatsApp, phone, email, and address.

items.q: I’m a charity organization. How do I get started?
Can I share Charity Link with others?
items.a: Yes. On the contributor home page you can share Charity Link with friends, family, and your community using WhatsApp, Instagram, email, and other channels.
